criteria.description: Additions, deletions, renames, content and mode/type changes are evaluated from signed base/head trees; candidate rules cannot weaken their own gate.

criteria.description: Protection affects status, acceptance validation, manual merge and fetched evidence admission. Exact candidate review evidence remains signed and independently verifiable. Current withdrawal blocks subsequent enabled merge. A target with protection enabled refuses manual merges governed by a different base-policy digest, including newly opened candidates against pre-opt-in ancestors; historical signed evidence remains valid.
criteria.notes: Verification pending implementation and independent review.

criteria.description: Policy inspection and amendment comparison expose activation, protected paths, thresholds, reviewers and automerge rule changes.

criteria.description: Explicitly configured automerge rules select a target branch, allowed executing actors, proposal authors and literal allowed paths. Only matching rules may run.
criteria.notes: Verification pending implementation and independent review.

criteria.description: Automerge defaults to read-only preview; execution is explicit and requires existing current approvals, passes and maintainer acceptances. It never manufactures reviews or decisions.
criteria.notes: Verification pending implementation and independent review.

criteria.description: Execution rechecks exact candidate, current evidence, policy, actor, branch and expected target. Stale targets, current change requests/rejections, protected changes, policy amendments and unmatched changes refuse automatic merge.
criteria.notes: Verification pending implementation and independent review.

criteria.description: Successful automation records the existing native merge event and retains manual merge repair behavior; neither preview nor execution implicitly syncs, pushes, starts a daemon or executes pipelines.
